item.name: Security Playbook and Response Automation — Karl Khouri

request.description: Karl Khouri — Reject analyst playbook creation. Run against your own backend and inspect the actual response.
Karl Khouri — Create playbook. Run against your own backend and inspect the actual response.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('playbookId', p.id); pm.environment.set('actionId', p.actions[0].id); pm.environment.set('action2Id', p.actions[1].id); }

request.description: Karl Khouri — List playbooks. Run against your own backend and inspect the actual response.
Karl Khouri — Get playbook. Run against your own backend and inspect the actual response.

exec: pm.test('Steps ordered', () => { const s = pm.response.json().actions.map(a => a.step_order); pm.expect(s).to.eql([...s].sort((a, b) => a - b)); });

exec: pm.test('Three creations and two transitions recorded', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().length).to.eql(5));
